purpose: Portable complete current metadata only; not history/ancestry or an image backup
limitations: Copied source documents retain their original old-machine absolute paths; use source-to-portable-mapping.jsonl to resolve them.
Freeze approval records previous producer stopping/source proofs. The old full-capture attempt was aborted; no aborted capture is represented as a successful current snapshot.
Image/source pixel mappings retain the previously pinned SHA and are not rehashed here. The fresh current snapshot builder must hash all remaining working bytes.
Historical Git OIDs in receipts are provenance only and do not require old commits to remain reachable.
Root must deploy this folder to the stated docs prefix before final inventory, and add the new final snapshot/source proof afterwards as its own portable evidence.
